# perf-functions

Simple performance profiling that reports time spent in each function.

Uses `perf record` followed by `perf report` to list functions sorted by
overhead. Outputs `RESULT-PERF-<symbol>@<pid>` for each function above the
`PERF_MIN` threshold.

For more advanced classification-based profiling, see the [`perf-class`](perf-class.md) module.

Usage:
```bash
%import@dut perf-functions PERF_TIME=5 PERF_MIN=2
```

Source: [`modules/perf-functions.npf`](https://github.com/tbarbette/npf/blob/main/modules/perf-functions.npf)

## Variables

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `PERF_OPT` | *empty* | Extra options for perf record and perf report |
| `PERF_TIME` | `4` | Recording duration in seconds |
| `PERF_EVENT` | `cycles` | Hardware event to record |
| `PERF_MIN` | `1` | Minimum overhead percentage to report |

```{collapse} Late variables

Late variables are evaluated after the variables above.

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `PERF_PATH` | `perf` | Path to the perf binary |
```
